svg.title: Most Valued Engineer: Abhishek Vishwakarma
svg.desc: One Piece style Most Valued Engineer poster for Abhishek Vishwakarma, for shipping perfect software in record time. Valued at 444,000,000 berries: 444 contributions in the last year times one million. 47 active days, peak day 59 contributions on Oct 29, longest streak 5 days. Engineering Atlas field edition.
